basic_profile.bio: I am a 36-year-old aquatic hobbyist living in Portland, Oregon. My passion for aquariums started as a child, and over the years, I've developed a knack for creating thriving aquatic ecosystems. When I'm not tending to my fish tanks, I work as a graphic designer for a local eco-friendly brand. I enjoy learning about different snail species and their roles in aquatic environments. In my free time, I also like hiking and photography. I am in a long-term relationship and often spend evenings online interacting with fellow aquarium enthusiasts.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep understanding of aquatic ecosystems, primarily self-taught through years of hands-on experience and research. I often read scientific articles and participate in online forums to stay updated on best practices in aquarium maintenance and snail biology.
